_comment: Simulator calibration parameters (docs/design/03 §4). Tuned with tools/sim_batch.gd.

quaffle._comfort: [game] Match already decided: with a lead of more than comfort_lead points (snitch aside, these are goals), the leading team attacks less and shoots less sharply, decreasing linearly down to comfort_min at comfort_lead + comfort_span. Curbs blowouts without touching close matches.

school._comment: [game] School calibration: applies only when both sides are houses (SimTeam.is_school, ids 'hs_'). Students would otherwise play professional-length, professional-tempo matches (playtest: 270-350, 370-110, a Keeper with 72 saves). quaffle_tempo_mult scales the Quaffle action chance per tick (fewer attacks per hour); snitch_sight_mult scales the Snitch sighting chance (earlier catch; with sight_ramp_power 2 the length scales roughly as mult^(-1/3)). Target, from the canon table below: winner ~230-260, loser ~20-80, about 10-20 goals in all, Keepers in the teens for saves. Professional, national-team and World Cup matches are untouched (both factors are 1.0). The Hogwarts results written in data/packs/*/events.json (fixture_result) bypass the simulator; this tunes every other school match (the other ten schools, Hogwarts seasons without a written result, the House World Cup).
